market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 20-year high Treasury yields, oil above $103, and consumer weakness. Equity futures flat after bond sell-off. Yen strength and Goldman's reversal create FX volatility. Expect choppy, risk-off conditions through Q4 with oil and yields as primary drivers. Trade truce expiration in 2 months is key binary event.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle remains multi-year structural tailwind. India capital market liberalization ($463B) creates 3-5 year equity inflow story. Defense spending cycle accelerates globally. However, sustained oil above $100 and 20-year high yields threaten to compress equity multiples. Housing market correction likely through 2027. AI consumer integration (Meta Muse, McDonald's AI) signals next phase of AI monetization.
